summary: OpenAI published an analysis identifying reliability and accuracy issues in the SWE-Bench Pro coding benchmark.

practices.reason: The analysis flags reliability problems in a widely used coding benchmark, which should inform how teams trust or weight SWE-Bench Pro results, but the summary gives no transferable method.
practices.quote: A new analysis from OpenAI reveals issues in SWE-Bench Pro, a popular coding benchmark, raising concerns about reliability and accuracy in evaluating AI models.
